title: Family
label: ch:hi-family
canDo: I can name my father, mother, brother and sister in Hindi.

payoff.summary: Say भाई and बहन beside पिता and माता, and name which one is a true cousin of English 'brother' and which is not.
payoff.note: HI-C12-bhaai-bahin now recalls पिता/माता's PIE cousins and the everyday बाप/माँ as well as its own pair: 4 of the chapter's 6 atoms. The two one-character recognition segments (HI-S07-letter-ta, HI-S116-vowel-sign-ii, sequence 585-586) come after the payoff in reading order, so they stay out of it; they belong to the script strand's own ramp.
